prompts.cabin: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: wide background artwork for a premium Dutch mythological bestiary website. Create a cinematic wide 16:9 illustrated naturalist's wooden study at dusk, viewed straight toward an antique walnut writing desk in the foreground. Bookshelves in deep shadow to the left, old pinned expedition maps and quiet carved wood in back, a rain-speckled tall window on the right with forest beyond, a warmly glowing brass oil lamp on the far right side of the desk, a few loose parchment papers and a quill at the edges. The center and top center are calm, dark and uncluttered so ivory website lettering can be overlaid. The bottom middle of the desk is clear of objects so three interactive upright book covers can be overlaid in code. Warm amber lamplight, deep olive-brown shadows, sophisticated painterly realism and vintage natural history book atmosphere, fine wood grain, restrained luminous dust, rich and tactile, premium literary editorial. Avoid people, creatures, book covers in center, text, logos, interface elements, bright fire, clutter, cartoon game design. Wide landscape composition.
